acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The protein gel pieces were subjected to tryptic digestion as described previously (Shevchenko et al., 2006).

cleavage_agent.evidence: The protein gel pieces were subjected to tryptic digestion as described previously (Shevchenko et al., 2006).

enrichment_method.evidence: For positive control (precipitation of endogenous Drp1), 4 μL Drp1-antibody was added to the lysate and after overnight incubation at 4 °C 80 μL equilibrated Protein A/G sepharose slurry were added followed by additional 3-4 hours incubation at 4 °C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Seven most intense multiple-charged ions were selected for HCD fragmentation with a dynamic exclusion period of 30 s and tandem MS (MS/MS) spectra were acquired at resolution of 15,000.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were ionized by nanospray ionization and a capillary temperature of 275 °C.

labeling.evidence: For label-free quantification a minimum ratio count of two was requested.
